narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for PL1__M3167AD3 shows a moderate demand pattern with average daily demand of 388 units. 
Lead time is volatile with a mean of 1.01 days. The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 781 units 
and order quantity of 3555 units (adjusted for storage constraints), achieving a 95.0% service level. 
This optimization delivers annual cost savings of $36,453.17 (92.5% reduction) compared to the current policy, 
primarily through reduced ordering frequency from 788 to 27 orders per year.
warnings: High demand variability (CV=0.72). Consider forecasting improvements.
High lead time variability (CV=0.99). Consider supplier reliability improvements.
Inventory levels near storage capacity limit. Monitor closely.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Classical EOQ model appropriate for moderate demand with volatile lead times. Safety stock computed using lead time demand variability formula.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage constraint binding; order quantity reduced from optimal EOQ.
